objective: Create campaigns in strict sequence starting at C12 while eliminating Meta code17 failures and scaling safely toward high-volume campaign creation.

first_attempt.result: objects created, final hierarchy readback blocked by Meta code17/subcode2446079, then fully cleaned

cumulative_postmortem_20260820.root_cause: The campaign runner incorrectly embedded a full portfolio reconciliation and repeated it on dry-runs and retries. Batch transport reduced HTTP connections but Meta still counted the hundreds of logical subrequests against the development-access app/account window.

immediate_changes_applied: Removed the wrong C50/C49 retry before execution.
Changed default numbering to contiguous C12,C13 and fail closed if either slot conflicts.
Changed creation to prepare campaigns PAUSED at 17:00 and activate campaign-only at/after 00:30.
Changed 12 individual video readiness GETs to one bounded Graph batch poll.
Persisted preflight_deferred and readback_deferred states with hourly cooldown resume.
Separated physical Drive READY count from ares_eligible stock.
Added current+paused+archived Meta reconciliation and excluded only technical IDs with cleanup evidence.

short_term_plan.goal: Complete the next production cycle without code17 on development access.
steps: After cooldown, perform one read-only live check for C12/C13 status, account budget and BUC header.
Resolve whether today's batch is only C12 or a controlled C12+C13 replacement; never skip ahead.
Stage and process media separately from campaign-object writes.
Use one batch readiness poll for all staged videos.
Prepare campaigns PAUSED with children ACTIVE and do one combined final hierarchy batch readback.
At 00:30, recheck holds, hierarchy and projected active budget, then activate only campaigns and validate by GET.
fail_closed: No write when next sequential slot is occupied without an explicit replacement decision.
No write when BUC/cooldown state predicts insufficient request budget.
No asset consumption until final preparation readback and Drive move to 02_TESTING.

stage_media.method: For one campaign: upload three vertical plus three square derivatives, then one batch readiness poll. For two campaigns, run this as a separate resumable phase before campaign-object creation.

stage_campaign_objects.method: Implement a BUC-aware Graph batch POST route after a one-campaign canary: batch campaign validations, batch campaign creates, batch adset validations/creates, batch six creative creates, batch ad validations/creates, one final hierarchy batch readback. Persist IDs between dependency boundaries.

stage_activation.method: One batch preflight, two single campaign status POSTs, one batch final readback, one budget readback; rollback only confirmed partial activation.

call_reduction_plan.request_budget_guard: Before each stage, read persisted BUC usage/tier/cooldown. Stop before the account hard limit and resume from fsynced state instead of continuing until code17.

reconciliation_scale_plan.full_baseline: Run current+paused+archived ads/creatives/media reconciliation once and persist Drive-to-Meta links.
reconciliation_scale_plan.incremental_daily: After baseline, query only new/updated Meta objects since the last checkpoint and known Page media deltas; do not rescan hundreds of historical media before every campaign batch.
reconciliation_scale_plan.inventory_drift: Repair 19 Drive-only files, 16 inventory-only READY records and four duplicate filename groups before counting affected lineages as eligible.

access_tier_plan.finding: The live BUC header identifies the current app as development_access, which is not an appropriate baseline for high-volume automation.
access_tier_plan.action: Audit the app in Meta App Dashboard and request/enable the applicable Standard/Advanced Marketing API access after business verification/app review as required. Do not change app, token or credential without Rodolfo approval.
access_tier_plan.comparison_with_ads_manager: Bulk creation through Ads Manager or another first-party/standard-tier route is not directly comparable to calls made by a development-access app. Confirm the friend's route/app/tier before using 40 campaigns as an API capacity benchmark.

validation_ramp: Canary A: prepare and validate C12 only.
Canary B: activate C12 at 00:30 and validate spend remains zero before activation.
Canary C: prepare two sequential campaigns after the C13 conflict decision.
Scale test: 10 paused campaigns with staged media and batch writes, zero delivery.
Capacity test: 40 paused campaigns only after Standard/Advanced access and explicit Rodolfo approval.
success_criteria: No code17 during the planned stage request budget.
Exact sequential numbering beginning at C12.
Every prepared campaign PAUSED with one ACTIVE adset and three ACTIVE ads.
Every activation campaign-only, within USD300 cap, with GET readback.
Physical READY and unique eligible stock reported separately after every creation.
